answer: The preferred reperfusion strategy for ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) is primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) within 90 minutes of first medical contact, as recommended over fibrinolysis. For all acute coronary syndrome patients, dual antiplatelet therapy involving aspirin plus a P2Y12 inhibitor is recommended, regardless of the reperfusion strategy employed [ACC/AHA Acute Coronary Syndrome Guideline, 2025].
